name: Build a Stone Miner! ⚒️
desc:
⛏️ Welcome to Build a Stone Miner!

💎 Break stones and collect valuable resources
⚙️ Upgrade your miner and storage to break even more
🌍 Unlock new zones and discover different types of stones
💰 Sell your stones and become the richest miner!

👍 Don’t forget to like the game and join the group for rewards!
🪨 Keep mining, keep growing, and build your legacy!
